content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Classification: deviation (fallback target)**

- **Responsive clauses:** §4.1 (p0024 — one-year term, annual auto-renewal, mutual 90-day termination with notice specifying any Termination Date), §4.2(a)–(c) (p0026–p0029 — Termination Payment formula, zero floor, instalments), plus §1.6 (p0011 — our no-penalty exit if the Site is not live in 70 days, a benefit to us that we left alone).
- **Fallback elements already met:** our 90 days' notice exit, and HDI's 90-day notice obligation (same operative words in §4.1).
- **Fallback elements failed:** HDI's notice can fix any termination date, so it is a mid-term convenience walk-away rather than a term-end right; and the Termination Payment (half of twelve months' Net Sales less $800,000) vastly exceeds a three-month fee cap.
- **Cure (two surgical edits):** added ", but in no event more than three (3) months of fees payable under Section 3" to §4.2(a), leaving the zero-floor and instalment mechanics coherent, and inserted one sentence making any HDI termination effective only at the end of the then-current term — without touching our own mid-term exit or the mutual notice period.
